answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement, making renewal unlikely to satisfy the mandated 18% reduction. Prior evidence indicates the low-cost vendor materially reduced unit cost and onboarded quickly, but its current delivery capacity, quality performance, and ability to support a near-full assembly line remain unverified. Verify the prior switch record and the second-source shortage record before committing; retain a tightly controlled transition or contingency arrangement if contract timing permits.
